tasks.description: Lists the endpoints of the current internal service specs with their auth requirement and owning team. Use when asked for an endpoint inventory of the service specs.
tasks.intent: Inventory the endpoints of the current service specs with auth and ownership.

tasks.description: Compares the old and new spec version of each service and separates breaking changes from other changes. Use when asked for the breaking changes between versions of the service specs.
tasks.intent: List breaking and other changes between old and new service spec versions.
